Rinse quinoa. Simmer in twice its volume of water for 15 minutes, then cover and rest for 5 minutes.
Drain cooked chickpeas and warm in a dry skillet until lightly golden. Chop the tomatoes and rinse the spinach.
Divide quinoa, chickpeas, tomatoes and spinach between two bowls. Toss gently and serve.
Rinse lentils and simmer in water until tender, about 20 minutes. Cook the rice separately according to its packet instructions.
Chop tomatoes and simmer in a saucepan for 5 minutes. Add the cooked lentils and coconut milk.
Simmer gently for 8 minutes until creamy. Divide rice and curry between two bowls.
Rinse spinach and chop the avocado. Warm the spinach in a covered pan with a splash of water until wilted.
Cook eggs in simmering water to your preferred firmness. Peel and cut in half.
Divide spinach and avocado between two plates. Top with the eggs and serve.
Cook rice according to packet directions. Cut tofu into cubes and broccoli into bite-sized florets.
Sear tofu in a nonstick pan, turning until golden. Steam broccoli until just tender.
Whisk peanut butter with warm water until pourable. Assemble two rice bowls with tofu, broccoli and peanut sauce.
Cook rice according to packet directions. Chop tomatoes and cut broccoli into florets.
Cook chicken in a nonstick pan, turning regularly, until cooked through. Steam broccoli separately.
Let chicken rest before slicing. Divide rice, chicken, broccoli and tomatoes between two bowls.
Mix oats and yogurt with enough water to loosen. Divide into two covered jars.
Refrigerate for at least 4 hours or overnight to soften the oats.
Slice banana and add just before serving. Stir well and enjoy chilled.
Heat the oven to 200°C. Place chopped tomatoes and feta in a baking dish and roast for 20 minutes.
Cook pasta according to packet directions, reserving a little cooking water before draining.
Stir the roasted tomatoes and feta into a sauce. Add pasta and spinach, loosening with reserved water. Divide into two servings.
Cook rice according to packet directions. Drain cooked chickpeas and warm in a pan.
Dice tomatoes and avocado. Keep the avocado aside until ready to serve.
Divide rice and chickpeas between two bowls. Add the tomato and avocado, then serve warm.
Mix coconut yogurt with oats and a splash of water. Allow to stand for 10 minutes so the oats soften.
Slice the banana and divide the yogurt mixture between two bowls.
Top with banana and serve. For softer oats, cover and refrigerate the mixture overnight.
Cook rice according to packet directions. Cut broccoli into florets and steam until tender.
Cook salmon in a nonstick pan, turning carefully, until cooked through and easily flaked.
Divide rice and broccoli between two bowls. Add salmon and sprinkle with sesame seeds.
Rinse quinoa and simmer in twice its volume of water for 15 minutes. Rest covered for 5 minutes and fluff.
Rinse spinach and tomatoes. Chop tomatoes and avocado into bite-sized pieces.
Allow quinoa to cool slightly, then toss with spinach, tomato and avocado. Divide between two bowls.
Cook rice according to packet directions. Rinse and roughly chop spinach.
Warm spinach in a nonstick pan with a splash of water. Add beaten eggs and stir until fully set.
Fold in the cooked rice and heat through. Divide between two bowls and serve immediately.
